svg.title: Activator profiles around the non-admissible score transition
svg.desc: Fine P1 FEM and independent conservative FD activator profiles at frozen recorded times before, near, and after the raw score crossing. These profiles are numerical diagnostics, not evidence of an admissible event or biology.
